_comment: The model catalogue both apps read. Bundled in each app, and re-fetched from catalogue_url on every update check so a newly published model shows up without an app release. A model with status 'planned' is listed as coming soon and cannot be downloaded. Protocol: shared/update-protocol.md. desktop/tests/test_shared.py fails if either app's bundled copy drifts from this file. 'recommended' (Android 0.6.0+) is the model new installs use when nothing is picked, and the one the Models screens badge (Sabich since 2026-10-21, Daniel: the complete model, Jachnun's code-switching plus tech; listed first); 'default' stays 'stock' because builds up to Android 0.5.0 and desktop 0.2.2 read it, and changing it would switch their users to a model they have not downloaded.
